title.zh: 【Ethlabs：FCR 集成 Chainlink CCIP 2.0，相关跨链场景中以太坊确认可降至 12–24 秒】 Foresight News 消息，非营
title.en: 【Ethlabs：FCR 集成 Chainlink CCIP 2.0，相关跨链场景中以太坊确认可降至 12–24 秒】 Foresight News 消息，非营

current_state.zh: Ethlabs has integrated Ethereum Fast Confirmation Rules into Chainlink CCIP 2.0, enabling an optional faster cross-chain path that can reduce Ethereum confirmations in relevant scenarios from about 13 minutes to 12–24 seconds without a hard fork.
current_state.en: Ethlabs has integrated Ethereum Fast Confirmation Rules into Chainlink CCIP 2.0, enabling an optional faster cross-chain path that can reduce Ethereum confirmations in relevant scenarios from about 13 minutes to 12–24 seconds without a hard fork.
